items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: Thin YoRHa scroll region on Base UI ScrollArea: 8px square thumb and track, corner patch, focusable viewport for native keyboard scrolling.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Compose ScrollArea, ScrollAreaViewport (give it aria-label), ScrollAreaScrollbar (orientation), ScrollAreaThumb, ScrollAreaCorner.
